detail.longDescription: git checkout <40-hex sha> does not pin a commit. If a branch has that exact name, checkout switches to the branch, while git rev-parse on the same string returns the commit. Plugin4Shell (AIR Security, Sep 17): Claude Code, Codex and GitHub Copilot installed pinned plugins with clone, then checkout <sha>. A default branch named after the SHA wins. The fix: compare git rev-parse HEAD to the pin. https://www. air.security/blog-posts/plugin 4shell # Git # AIAgents # Cybersecurity
